song.title: No Feed No Ads
song.style: English, mellow reggae with offbeat guitar, warm organ, deep bass, laid-back male vocal, 80 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Nobody paid me for this sunset
Nobody's selling me the breeze
Took a walk in my favorite tee
Brought a friend and some sweet peas

[Chorus]
No feed, no ads, no end
Just a long road and a friend
No feed, no ads, no end
Round the bend and round again

shots.prompt: A man walks toward the camera along a country path in a cream t-shirt, giving a big thumbs up and a wink. The camera tracks backward. Bright morning sun.
Two friends share a slice of watermelon sitting on a stone wall beside the path, laughing. Static medium shot. Warm sunny light.
A woman picks blackberries from a hedge along the path and pops one in her mouth, eyes closing with delight. Close-up. Dappled light.
A goat pokes its head over a fence and nibbles a man's straw hat as he laughs. Static medium shot. Bright midday light.

A cream t-shirt with a simple illustration of rolling green hills and a winding path shaped like an infinity loop lies flat on a sunny wooden picnic table next to a basket of apples, a light breeze lifting its sleeve. Soft daylight, warm shadows. Slow overhead push in.
A couple sits on a hilltop bench sharing a thermos of tea, the path winding down into a valley below. Static wide shot. Golden afternoon light.
A kid skips a stone across a lake, the stone bouncing many times, and pumps a fist. Side view. Glittering afternoon light.
A man lies in tall grass with his hat over his face as a butterfly lands on the hat. Static close-up. Warm late light.
Two friends walk away down a winding path into the sunset, arms over each other's shoulders. The camera slowly rises. Peach and gold, calm.

endcard.line1: No feed. No ads. No end.

caption: This walk is not sponsored. Neither is the sunset. The Infinite Stroll tee just came along for the ride.
